headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 20, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 24.40% compared to SPY's 13.27%. This outperformance indicates that the portfolio is not only rising in absolute terms but also generating an average alpha of 11.13%. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 45.26%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 10.07%, reflecting a more modest performance. Such relative strength against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market stress or macroeconomic uncertainty, highlighting the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
